system_note: Claim MR_SNF_07, revenue code 0192 billed 10 units for 2026-01-08 through 2026-01-21. Medical record supports skilled PT/OT services on multiple dates but the retrieved, citable daily nursing/therapy notes do not document all 10 distinct dates that would be required to verify the full 10 billed 0192 days. Evidence: the Admission H&P documents transfer to the SNF for skilled PT/OT/nursing (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_07.pdf-n10, p.8) and the interdisciplinary plan documents PT/OT frequency of 5-7x/week (NOTE-SNF-medical-records-MR_SNF_07.pdf-n12, pp.10-11). The Treatment Administration Records (TARs) available and retrieved show explicit PT and/or OT sessions documented on the following dates (cited below): 01/08 (n120 p139), 01/09 (n121 p140), 01/12 (n124 p143), 01/13 (n125 p144), 01/14 (n126 p145), 01/15 (n127 p146), and 01/16 (n128 p147). Each of those TAR entries documents PT 60 minutes and/or OT 45 minutes completed per schedule and therefore supports those specific dates as skilled therapy days. However, the claim bills 10 units at 0192 and the retrieved TARs with source_ids only document therapy sessions on seven citable dates; therapy-session rows for 01/19-01/21 were returned by the system's service-minute extraction tool (non-source_id rows) but those session rows lack a medical-record source_id in the retrieval set and therefore cannot be cited as supporting evidence in this audit. Additionally, there are pre-flagged internal record conflicts (CONFLICT-00287 and CONFLICT-00288) indicating the facility billing summary/discharge summary and the daily skilled nursing progress notes disagree about which days are at which per-diem level; those conflicts were flagged as "do not trust: either" and the record does not resolve them. Because the documentation set in the retrieval does not provide citable, day-by-day per-diem determinations or citable therapy/TAR entries for all billed 10 days at 0192, I cannot reliably confirm that the full billed 10 units at revenue code 0192 are supported. Action: Insufficient Evidence - request the missing citable daily therapy/TAR notes (with source_ids) for 01/19-01/21 or an explicit facility daily per-diem-level note mapping which dates were billed at 0192 versus 0191, and resolution of the internal billing-summary vs. daily-progress-note conflict (CONFLICT-00287 / CONFLICT-00288). Citations to the supporting passages used are below. Claim MR_SNF_07 - revenue code 0191 line (dates 2026-01-08 to 2026-01-21): reviewed available record extracts and governing per-diem reference guide. The payer-agnostic SNF Level-of-Care reference defines the criterion that must be met to support a 0191 billed day as a "skilled need" (requires licensed nursing or therapy involvement) and also maps revenue codes to level names (0191 = skilled nursing) (RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b6; RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b8). The guide also allows individual days within a stay to be non-covered when documentation for that specific day does not support the billed level (RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b11). The dataset returned daily therapy sessions for many dates in the stay (PT/OT sessions on 2026-01-08, 01-09, 01-12 through 01-16, 01-19 through 01-21) indicating licensed therapy involvement on those dates; however, the retrieval rows that list the session minutes were delivered without a source_id and therefore are not citable as the medical-record evidence required for an audit determination. The facility's per-diem-level extraction (get_per_diem_level_notes) returned null for all dates (no explicit daily level-exception statements), which the reference guide explains is commonly the case when the billed level was met, but those per-date null rows also lack a citable source_id in the extraction results. In addition, there are known record conflicts noted pre-review (CONFLICT-00287 / CONFLICT-00288) that indicate the facility billing statement and the discharge summary disagree with the billed lines; those specific sections were marked in the pre-check as not to be relied on without reconciliation. Because the minutes/session rows and the facility daily-level notes needed to map each billed day to the documented level are present in the retrieval output but lack citable source_ids, and because the record contains unresolved conflicts about which days were intended to be billed at each per-diem level, I cannot make a defensible Finding (downcode or adjust units) from the available, citable evidence. Action: escalate to a human reviewer to (1) reconcile the facility billing statement and discharge summary conflict (CONFLICT-00287/00288) and confirm the date-to-revenue-code mapping for the 0191 and 0192 billed days, and (2) supply the medical-record source_ids or PDF pages for the daily therapy/nursing progress notes (the PT/OT session notes and the facility daily skilled-nursing progress notes) so the therapist minutes and the facility's per-day level statements can be cited directly and each date assessed against the per-diem criteria. Citations used in this note: RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b6 (Skilled need), RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b8 (Revenue codes 0191-0194), RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b11 (Non-covered day).
rationale_letter:
Re: MR_SNF_07 - SNF Per-Diem Review (01/08/2026-01/21/2026)

Dear Provider,

We completed an audit of the SNF per-diem revenue lines on this claim, which billed 10 day(s) at Rev Code 0192 (Level 2, rehabilitation therapy), 3 day(s) at Rev Code 0191 (Level 1, skilled nursing) for 01/08/2026-01/21/2026.

Basis for Finding:
- The facility's Skilled Nursing Progress Notes record the per-diem level for each day of the stay; they document Level 1, skilled nursing (Rev 0191) on 14 day(s).
- Under the SNF level-of-care guidance, each billed day is held to the level its own documentation supports (per-day adjustment), not the stay as a whole.

Correction Applied:
- Rev Code 0191: 3 day(s) billed; corrected to 13 day(s).
- Rev Code 0192: 10 day(s) billed; corrected to 0 day(s).
- The claim's revenue lines share one date range, so the claim does not identify which dates the recoded days fall on.

Recovery Type: Partial Recovery - rate differential on 10 of 13 billed days.

If you believe additional documentation supports the billed level for specific days, please submit it with a request for reconsideration within the timeframe specified in the applicable provider manual and appeal rights notice.

Sincerely,
Clinical Review Team
